title: POST /chat — request body and the text/event-stream events it returns

text.description: final STT transcript of one user utterance

sources.when: once, if the persona has a knowledge block (strict KB answers)

sentence.when: each spoken sentence as soon as it is ready; play immediately

interrupted.when: a newer /chat for the same session superseded this one (barge-in); drop remaining events

ordering: meta -> backchannel? -> sources? -> sentence* -> (interrupted | final | error)
